en: Fixed plugins silently skipping a bundled `.mcpb` MCP server that still needs configuration: `/plugin`, the install message and `claude plugin install` now say so and point to Configure
zh: 修复了 plugins 静默跳过仍需配置的捆绑 `.mcpb` MCP server 的问题：`/plugin`、安装消息和 `claude plugin install` 现在会提示这一点并指向 Configure
